persona: Fintech product manager who shipped one GenAI feature
resumeText:
Neha Iyer | Mumbai | neha.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Product Manager, Arabian Sea Fintech, Mumbai (2021 - present)
- Launched a GenAI support assistant using an LLM with RAG over 3,000 help articles.
- Wrote PRDs and user stories for the assistant and the loan dashboard.
- Ran 25 customer interviews to find why users abandoned loan applications.
- Own the quarterly roadmap and prioritised the backlog with engineering leads.
- Track deflection rate, CSAT and weekly active users in product dashboards.
- Present monthly product reviews to the risk, legal and operations heads.

Associate Product Manager, Powai Payments, Mumbai (2019 - 2021)
- Ran A/B tests on the UPI onboarding flow with the growth team.

SKILLS
Product roadmaps, SQL, Jira, Machine learning basics, LLM evaluation

EDUCATION
MBA, Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, 2019
